purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian retail POS (PDV - Ponto de Venda) system; transfers critical points data per PDV between company/branch directories. Generated by FonteSeguro version 05.00.05.00 on 30/06/2016.
purpose.summary: This program (STBEFW082) performs a base transfer of file EFW082.CAD (WCF08200.cpy - Pontos Críticos por PDVs, i.e. Critical Points by POS terminals) between source and destination directories for specified company/branch combinations. It reads records from the origin indexed file, converts company/branch codes to destination values, and writes them to the destination file, logging progress and errors throughout.
